packageRules.description: Bump the ruff pin in pyproject.toml and the ruff-pre-commit rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml as a single PR. Renovate manages the pre-commit rev only when the pre-commit manager is enabled above; without both settings it updates pyproject alone and CI's ruff drifts ahead of pre-commit's, which is exactly how the two gates ended up enforcing different rule sets (see #17).
